sentences.en: Victims of the hurricane received financial aid from the government.
sentences.zh: 飓风的受害者从政府获得了经济援助。

sentences.en: The category of a hurricane depends on its wind speed.
sentences.zh: 飓风的类别取决于它的风速。

sentences.en: The scarecrow in the backyard fell over during the hurricane.
sentences.zh: 后院里的稻草人被飓风吹倒了。

senses.zh: 飓风，十二级风,飓风般猛烈的东西,（感情等的）爆发,<英>飓风式战斗驱逐机

mnemonic: twister 龙卷风，tornado 龙卷风
